nodes.label: AutoClickTest.kt
AutoClickTest
.player()
.`the default rules give 500, 250, 150, 100 and 50 ms for levels 0 to 4`()
Test
.`the next upgrade of each level costs 10, 25, 50 and 100 crystals`()
.`there is no next upgrade at level 4`()
.`rules with a price count that does not match the levels fail`()
.`rules whose interval does not get faster fail`()
.`rules with a price under 1 fail`()
.`an upgrade from the held level raises it by one and takes the price`()
.`an upgrade keeps the crystals the price did not take`()
.`an upgrade from another level is a mismatch carrying the stored state`()
.`an upgrade at level 4 is refused as max level`()
.`an upgrade while locked is refused`()
.`an upgrade with fewer crystals than the price is refused`()
.`a stale request is a mismatch before the max level, the lock and the crystals`()
.`the max level is checked before the lock and the crystals`()
.`the lock is checked before the crystals`()
.`a negative fromLevel is an invalid request`()
.`the auto click is locked in chapter 1 and open from chapter 2 or on a completed campaign`()
.`an applied upgrade logs the username, the levels and the crystals at info`()
.`every refused upgrade logs the username, the levels and the crystals at warn`()
